! Note: no enable secret on the device: with AAA on and the server unreachable, a local user with
! privilege 15 is the only way to level 15.
! Note: privilege exec all level 7 monitor capture: not on the device, which holds 'privilege exec
! level 7 monitor' instead, as an image that does not know 'capture' stores it; a device that lost the
! line looks the same, so it stays missing.
! The change is live when the paste ends. NOTHING rolls it back by itself. Keep a second terminal
! logged in at privilege 15 until the end.
! Paste over ssh, not the console; on a console paste at most twenty lines at a time and watch the

! Type this first, on dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200, and check the name:   show version | include uptime
! The prompt must end in # (privileged mode), not in (config)#, before you paste: a prompt ending in >
! means type enable first, a prompt with (config) in it means a configuration session is open: type
! end first.

!!!!! PASTE FROM HERE: dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200 !!!!!
configure terminal
! roles: the privilege lines of the levels tacctl renders
privilege exec all level 7 monitor capture
privilege exec level 7 clear mac address-table dynamic
end
